monotonicity: Every max-vote correction on a connected error component of size <=4 is a subset of the true errors; no false apartment is introduced.
component_proof: Distinct chart-sharing components occur in no common chart, so global voting decomposes over components. Weight-four partitions then imply at most three sweeps globally.
boundary: Finite hard-decision Hamming guarantee only. Weight five is handled separately by Pass5131.
